title: Calgary's Forgotten Streetcars: How Rail Vanished and Came Back as the CTrain
script: Long before the CTrain, Calgary had streetcars. In 1909 the first cars rolled to the exhibition grounds. Streetcar suburbs like South Calgary, Marda Loop, Bowness Park. 1946 trolley coaches and gas buses. Last streetcar 1950. CTrain opened 1981 from Anderson Road to 7 Avenue downtown. Retired streetcar motor-conductors rode the first run. The last streetcar sits at Heritage Park.
